name: 东方同人曲包
author: Yuuka
description:
需要DTMAPI 0.7.5以上。
在农场的背景音乐池中加入：
《Bad Apple》
《色は匂へど散りぬるを》
《月に叢雲華に風》
《Bad Apple》默认在随身听解锁；其余磁带在工坊贸易部（电话亭）出售，每盒 100 螺母。

localized_description.english:
Requires DTMAPI 0.7.5 or later.
Adds these tracks to the farm's background music rotation:
Bad Apple
色は匂へど散りぬるを
月に叢雲華に風
Bad Apple is unlocked on the portable music player by default. The other cassettes are sold at the Workshop Trade Department (phone booth) for 100 Nuts each.
